name: Black File Dark Tee
description: Some files were never meant to leave the cabinet. Black File Dark brings redacted documents, surveillance symbols, and a very unhelpful security clearance out into the open. A distressed cream-and-red graphic on darker garment colors, printed on the heavyweight Comfort Colors 1717. Classified until never.
garment: Comfort Colors 1717 · Unisex Garment-Dyed Heavyweight T-Shirt
fitNotes: Relaxed unisex fit in 100% ring-spun cotton. The 6.1 oz/yd² (206.8 g/m²) fabric is garment-dyed and pre-shrunk, with a substantial feel. Double-needle stitching and a twill-taped neck and shoulders finish the construction. Garment dyeing and softening can produce slight color variations.
story: For late-night researchers, chronic footnote readers, and anyone who thinks a heavily redacted page is an invitation. Wear the evidence. Keep your sources to yourself.
